name: dsh
title: DeepSeek Harness
description: Control the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: a global-hotkey toggle for its window, plus show, hide, restart and quit.
author: blanit

commands.name: toggle-dsh
commands.title: Toggle DSH Window
commands.subtitle: DeepSeek Harness
commands.description: Hide the DSH window while it is the active window; otherwise reveal and focus it. Assign a global hotkey to this command.

commands.name: show-dsh
commands.title: Show DSH Window
commands.subtitle: DeepSeek Harness
commands.description: Reveal, restore and focus the DSH window. Starts the desktop app when it is not running.

commands.name: hide-dsh
commands.title: Hide DSH Window
commands.subtitle: DeepSeek Harness
commands.description: Hide the DSH window to the notification area. Running tasks keep going, exactly like the shell's own close button.

commands.name: dsh-status
commands.title: DSH Status
commands.subtitle: DeepSeek Harness
commands.description: Inspect the DSH process, window and harness home, and run the other commands from one list.

preferences.name: executablePath
preferences.title: Application Path
preferences.description: Full path to DeepSeek Harness.exe. Leave empty to detect it from the running app or the default install location.

preferences.name: processName
preferences.title: Process Name
preferences.description: Image name of the desktop shell, without the .exe extension.

preferences.name: launchIfNotRunning
preferences.title: Launch When Not Running
preferences.description: Start the DSH desktop app when a command finds it not running. Turn this off to make the commands report instead of launching.
preferences.label: Launch DSH automatically

preferences.name: launchTimeout
preferences.title: Launch Timeout
preferences.description: Seconds to wait for the window after launching DSH.
